sources.use: Tetrahedron10 connectivity, integration-point Jacobians, high-order mesh handling and OpenCASCADE extrusion.
RF interpretation: sum of reaction and applied concentrated/distributed nodal loads. Version2.23 behavior separately checked against actual equilibrium.

method_note: For straight-sided tetra10 under constant gravity, integrals of corner shape functions are -V/20 and midside functions V/5. The pipeline subtracts these distributed nodal loads at supports from RF to recover pure reactions. Clipped T6 face pressure is integrated with exact quadratic triangle quadrature over a 10x10mm patch.
